paper_metadata.title: LongCat-Flash Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract:
We introduce LongCat-Flash, a 560-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model designed for both computational efficiency and advanced agentic capabilities. Stemming from the need for scalable efficiency, LongCat-Flash adopts two novel designs: (a) Zero-computation Experts, which enables dynamic computational budget allocation and activates 18.6B-31.3B (27B on average) per token depending on contextual demands, optimizing resource usage. (b) Shortcut-connected MoE, which enlarges the computation-communication overlap window, demonstrating notable gains in inference efficiency and throughput compared to models of a comparable scale. We develop a comprehensive scaling framework for large models that combines hyperparameter transfer, model-growth initialization, a multi-pronged stability suite, and deterministic computation to achieve stable and reproducible training. Notably, leveraging the synergy among scalable architectural design and infrastructure efforts, we complete model training on more than 20 trillion tokens within 30 days, while achieving over 100 tokens per second (TPS) for inference at a cost of \$0.70 per million output tokens. To cultivate LongCat-Flash towards agentic intelligence, we conduct a large-scale pre-training on optimized mixtures, followed by targeted mid- and post-training on reasoning, code, and instructions, with further augmentation from synthetic data and tool use tasks. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that, as a non-thinking foundation model, LongCat-Flash delivers highly competitive performance among other leading models, with exceptional strengths in agentic tasks. The model checkpoint of LongCat-Flash is open-sourced to foster community research.

extraction_data.innovation: ScMoE architecture: reorders execution to allow dense FFN computation to run in parallel with MoE dispatch/combine communication, creating a larger overlap window than shared-expert designs without compromising quality; Scale-Correction for MLA: introduces scale-correction factors α_q and α_kv to align variances of low-rank q/kv components with the full model dimension, stabilizing attention scores during scaling; Variance Compensation for Experts initialization: applies a scaling factor γ to counteract variance reduction caused by decomposing experts into finer-grained ones, improving stability across different expert counts and top-k settings.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: General web content (custom trafilatura), STEM material, high-quality books and novels, repository-level source code
extraction_data.hardware_used: H800, tens of thousands of accelerators
extraction_data.extension: ScMoE enables a Single Batch Overlap pipeline, reducing theoretical Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT) by nearly 50% compared to DeepSeek-V3, and allows concurrent execution of intra-node Tensor Parallelism and inter-node Expert Parallelism communications.
extraction_data.research_problem: Efficient MoE training and inference by reducing communication overhead in expert parallelism.
extraction_data.application: General domains, coding, agentic tool use, multi-turn instruction following, real-world business scenarios
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Single-turn and multi-turn instruction-following datasets, long-sequenced datasets (reading comprehension, table-based QA, custom-designed tasks), safety data (40+ categories, 5 response types), VitaBench
extraction_data.hardware_description: Distributed training over 30 days; inference optimized for >100 TPS at $0.70 per million output tokens
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), Multi-head Attention (MHA), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with scale-correction factors α_q and α_kv, Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with 64 heads
extraction_data.context_extension_method: RoPE base frequency scaling (raised from 1,000,000 to 5,000,000 to 10,000,000)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training -> mid-training (reasoning, code, instructions) -> post-training (synthetic data, tool use tasks)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Multi-agent synthesis framework defining task difficulty across information processing, tool-set complexity, and user interaction, Knowledge graph traversal and node combination, multi-stage iterative refinement, dual-modality generation and verification
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Generative reward model enhanced with reasoning data
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Four major risk categories: Harmful, Criminal, Misinformation, Privacy
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: V-ZB algorithm for pipeline parallelism memory balancing; pipelined all-gather/reduce-scatter kernels
